observations: Studied visible pairs bell/lake,kite/plum,leaf/door; predicted cannot know covered performance until trying.
Locking covered the source. Each cue button cycles supplied answers; leaf firstdoor, bell firstlane thenlake, kite firstplum.
Selected all correct and checked, producing3/3. Original answers reappeared after check.
Reveal accurately handled the all-correct case: nothing missed, only covered attempt establishes that, and explicitly denied a long-term memory score.

complexity.conceptualDemand: Supported reading versus a covered test.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Cycling answer buttons rather than typing.

whyCool: It can demonstrate why testing matters even when the learner gets every answer right.
caveat: Cycling pre-supplied options permits recognition cues, so this is not pure free recall; the showing3/3 baseline is assigned from legibility rather than an actual prior response test.
effort: Completed study, prediction, three covered selections, check, screenshots and reveal.
bucketReason: Actual learner response and careful perfect-score interpretation with limited memory claims.

prediction.reason: Asks whether reading accuracy establishes unassisted performance, with explicit uncertainty option.

interaction.reason: Source actually hides and selected answers receive matching feedback.
interaction.evidence: Three independent cue responses, perfect score accepted.

payoff.reason: Accurately adapts to a perfect score rather than inventing a deficit.
payoff.evidence: Nothing missed this time and one-attempt limit.

clarity.reason: Study, covered response and post-check states are explicit.

transfer.reason: Concrete checking procedure and evidence boundary are explicit.
transfer.evidence: Cover answers to remove reading route; not long-term retention.

surprise.reason: No mismatch on tested attempt; insight is about evidence.

playfulness.reason: Choosing responses creates a small memory task.

depth.reason: Distinguishes reading, current performance and long-term retention.
